messages:
maya: quick sweep — inc842 postmortem actions attached. Can folks confirm ownership + realistic due dates? Trying to close by end of next week but ok to stagger if blocked.

jordan: I can take the autoscaler follow-up (item 3). target EOD Thu next week. blocking: need the load test histogram from perf team. @lee can you share that?

sam: I’ll own the DB migration rollback plan (item 1). estimating Mon 3/14 for the first draft. will open a draft PR and post link here.

lee: I’ll provide perf histograms by tomorrow noon. FYI the migration rollback needs a small schema shim — that’s a separate PR on my plate, can do by Wed. so sam’s Monday draft sounds fine.

jordan: noted. updated due for autoscaler to Thu 3/17 in the sheet.

maya: thanks. two clarifications: (1) who owns the pager runbook update (item 2)? (2) who does the post-cutover verification scripts (item 4)?

sam: I can do the pager runbook update (2). Will add step-by-step and a one-click runbook snippet. planning Wed 3/16.

lee: I’ll take post-cutover verification scripts (4) but need someone to own the canary rollout schedule. @jordan?

jordan: I can coordinate the canary schedule and oncall handoff. Suggest canary window Thu 3/17 10:00-14:00 PT, then full rollout Fri if green. Ops oncall should be present for the first hour.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: "inc842 action owners check-in" at 2628473700 (03/15 09:00).

maya: perfect. @sam @jordan @lee please add your PR links in the sheet and ping if dates slip. I’ll mark items as staggered in the postmortem: rollback (Mon), runbook (Wed), perf + autoscaler (Thu), canary (Thu) -> full (Fri).

sam: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/3571 — draft for rollback plan. feedback welcome. :coffee:

jordan: prepping autoscaler PR, will tag reviewers by EOD.

lee: added perf hist and a short note about the shim to the sheet. small risk: shim may require a quick QA pass, calling that a 24h buffer.

maya: acknowledged. thanks everyone — I’ll send a final ownership snapshot after the ops-bot reminder tomorrow. :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: Note: all action items created in the incident tracker (inc842) with owners mapped. Use /incident status inc842 to view.
